name: Plane Marching
definition: A raymarching technique where a ray is marched along plane intersections separating voxel layers. It checks voxels at intersection points for solidity, stepping to the closest plane intersection along X, Y, or Z axes.
summary: Plane Marching is a simple raymarching technique for voxel grids that steps to the nearest integer grid plane intersection, distinguishing itself by requiring no auxiliary distance fields or shape metadata.
